data.gender_notes: Prabhu is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Prabhu is recorded with the meaning “Lord, Master”. Prabhu is a Hindu name meaning “Lord, Master”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prabhu expresses “Lord, Master”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: prabhU
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has control, rules, and protects. A master, lord, or deity.

in_hindi.name: प्रभु
in_hindi.long_meaning: PrabhAvI: powerful, PaviTra: pure, shaktiShAlI: full of power.

in_tamil.name: பிரபு
in_tamil.long_meaning: puruShAlar: lord, vadikkal: protector, Ātmā: self, soul.

in_telugu.name: ప్రభు
in_telugu.long_meaning: prabhAvI: powerful, pUjI: worshipper, shaktiPojI: worshipper of power.

in_marathi.name: Prabhu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prabhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is the master, the controller, the ruler.

in_bengali.name: Prabhu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord, Master
in_bengali.long_meaning: Prabhu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is the master, the controller, the ruler.
